title: chaos-mode onprem upgrade: kubelet-throttle + liveness probe regression causing operator resync storms
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Summary: During a staged rollout of onprem operator release on March 10, several customers reported control-plane instability after Helm post-upgrade hooks completed. Symptoms included operator leader flapping, sustained API request queueing, and accelerated KV cache evictions for tenant namespaces. Root cause surface: a coordinated regression across three subsystems: (1) a livenessProbe change introduced in operator container that shortened probe timeout under bursty workloads, (2) kubelet CPU throttling on constrained nodes which delayed readiness transitions and caused repeated restart cycles, and (3) a TTL mismatch between the operator's KV eviction policy and the post-upgrade cache snapshot logic which caused premature cache invalidations and subsequent heavy re-syncs across shards. The combination triggered a storm of reconcile loops and overwhelmed tenant RPC proxies, resulting in elevated latency and a handful of 503s for Dedicated/Private customers during the window.
mitigation_and_actions: Immediate mitigation (Mar 10 09:40 UTC): rolled operator back to previous helm chart revision via emergency helm rollback for affected tenants, disabled post-upgrade cache snapshotting with runtime feature-flag for shards < 10, and temporarily increased leader-election lease to 60s to reduce leader churn.

Hotfix (Mar 10 14:20 UTC): backported probe config to use readinessProbe only + increased liveness timeout to 25s, adjusted operator default KV eviction TTL to match snapshot window, and added jittered resync exponential backoff to reconcile loops.

Customer communication: sent incident bulletin to oncall CSMs and affected customers at 10:05 UTC with mitigation steps and ETA for hotfix. Direct Slack threads opened with top 5 customers reporting errors.

Observability: added temporary grafana dashboard panels for leader election rate, reconcile loop rate per-tenant, KV eviction events, and kubelet throttling metrics. Set alert threshold: leader-election-rate > 3/min triggers paging.
Rollback safety: implemented a helm preflight check to detect mismatched imagePullPolicy and secret annotation entropy before next rollout to avoid config drift re-triggering.
Post-deploy monitoring: validated heap/latency metrics for 6 hours after hotfix; no recurrence observed on rolled-forward tenants.
Follow-ups scheduled below as action items.
timeline_comments: 2026-03-10 08:53 UTC - Customer reported: sudden 503s and timeouts during scheduled onprem upgrade. Escalated to SEV1.
2026-03-10 09:12 UTC - Triage: observed leader-election churn in controller logs and spikes in reconcile loops. Noted recent helm chart change that reduced liveness timeout from 30s -> 5s.
2026-03-10 09:40 UTC - Emergency helm rollback executed for 8 affected tenants; CSMs notified. Partial stabilization within 12 minutes for most tenants.
2026-03-10 11:00 UTC - Root cause hypothesis confirmed: livenessProbe regression + kubelet throttling + KV TTL mismatch. Created targeted patch and tests.
2026-03-10 14:20 UTC - Hotfix PR opened and merged: github.com/redwood-inference/onprem-operator/pull/8929 (backport to 2026.03.1). CI green; staged rollout to canary tenants.
2026-03-10 16:05 UTC - Canary tenants healthy. Began rolling hotfix to remaining tenants with throttled concurrency (5 tenants / 10m).

2026-03-11 02:30 UTC - Monitoring: no leader churn or mass evictions observed. Some tenants with constrained nodes still showed transient kubelet CPU throttling; ops requested node sizing guidance to customers.
2026-03-12 09:00 UTC - Postmortem draft created; waiting on Engineering Manager and SRE signoff. This ticket updated to In Review for final closure.
2026-03-12 12:10 UTC - Release note prepared and sent to Docs/CS. Proposed release: onprem-operator-2026.03.1 with explicit node sizing recommendation and helm preflight check in CHANGES.md.
2026-03-12 15:45 UTC - Action owner assignments completed (see follow-ups).
